title: Natural standard-Ext comparison with derived terminal evaluation
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], V a terminal object of X.Etale, and E the additive evaluation-at-V functor on abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. For every sheaf F and n >= 0 there exist simultaneously additive equivalences e(F,n): H^(n+1)(X.Etale,F) -> R^(n+1)E(F), natural for every coefficient morphism F -> G. The left side is constant-integer-sheaf Ext in the standard large HasExt model [def-pc-ext, def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]; the right side is Mathlib right-derived evaluation in the coefficient universe. No direct-image functor or acyclicity hypothesis is involved.

proof.text: Use the explicit constant-integer-sheaf complexEvaluationIso from the derived-evaluation module. Its degreewise evaluationEquiv_naturality proves commutation with every coefficient chain map, using the generic proved postMap helper from the Ext-derived comparison module.

Compose Ext-to-cohomology-class, the homology of the complex evaluation isomorphism, preservation of homology by ULift, and the injective-resolution computation of right-derived evaluation. All data are explicit constructions, with the standard large HasExt instance.

Lift each coefficient morphism with InjectiveResolution.desc. The proved generic extClass_naturality and homologyClass_naturality helpers in the Ext-derived comparison module, followed by mapHomologyIso_hom_naturality and isoRightDerivedObjCochainComplex_inv_naturality, give naturality of this composite. Apply ULift.down and package the simultaneous family.

theorem etaleCohomologyNaturalDerivedEvaluation
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (V : X.Etale) (hV : IsTerminal V) :
    let E := sheafToPresheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⋙
      (CategoryTheory.evaluation X.Etaleᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op V)
    ∃ e : ∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (n : ℕ),
        @Sheaf.H _ _ X.smallEtaleTopology F inferInstance (HasExt.standard _) (n + 1) ≃+
          ((E.rightDerived (n + 1)).obj F),
      ∀ (F G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (φ : F ⟶ G) (n : ℕ)
        (x : @Sheaf.H _ _ X.smallEtaleTopology F inferInstance
          (HasExt.standard _) (n + 1)),
        e G n (@Sheaf.H.map _ _ X.smallEtaleTopology inferInstance (HasExt.standard _)
          _ _ φ (n + 1) x) = (E.rightDerived (n + 1)).map φ (e F n x)
